transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the weekly training synchronization. I need to go around the room for roster, qualification, scheduling, and facility updates before I publish next week's training schedule. As a reminder, the draft has Transport Section vehicle-recovery training on Tuesday 0900 to 1100, and Generator Section load-bank training on Wednesday 0900 to 1100. Who wants to start with their updates?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, my roster audit completed this morning shows that exactly five of the eight Transport operators lack current vehicle-recovery-equipment qualification and must attend the recertification block. The other three are already qualified. I should note that the updated roster has not yet been entered in the training tracker.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a facility conflict. I confirmed this morning that the Generator Training Pad is reserved for calibration work on Wednesday from 0900 to 1300. That means the Generator Section's load-bank session cannot use the Wednesday 0900 to 1100 slot from the draft. It needs to be moved to Monday from 1300 to 1500. I should also note that the facility calendar still shows the recurring Wednesday slot, so it hasn't been updated yet to reflect the calibration reservation.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. SFC Morgan, so five of eight Transport operators need the recertification block — got it. And those three who are already qualified won't need to attend. Please get that roster update into the training tracker as soon as we're done here. Please get the facility calendar updated to reflect that calibration reservation and the new training slot. Are there any other roster, qualification, scheduling, or facility updates from anyone else before I publish the schedule?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: No additional updates from me, Ma'am. I'll get the roster update into the training tracker as soon as we wrap up here.
